timeline.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited, sole promoter of Maharashtra Scooters Limited, declared no encumbrance on its shares in FY2025-26 via Saurabh Erande (signed by SURENDRA SURENDRAERANDE).
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹6.03 Cr (-9.3% YoY), net profit ₹4.01 Cr (-92.2% YoY).
2026-10-16: Maharashtra Scooters Limited received a fresh certificate of incorporation from MCA, changing its name to Bajaj Nivesh Limited with effect from 16 October 2026.
Bajaj Nivesh reported Q2 standalone net profit of ₹293.27 Cr on revenue of ₹297.36 Cr.
